turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Our lawn looks terrible and I'm trying to figure out what to do with it.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me lay out all the options first. Don't interrupt.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One option is to reseed the whole thing in the fall and water it a lot for a few weeks.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Another is to lay new sod, which looks perfect right away but costs a lot more.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or we could replace part of it with a gravel patio and some low plants that don't need much water.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, that's all. Which sounds best to you?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Reseeding in the fall is the cheapest way to get a nice lawn, it just takes patience. Sod is instant, but you're paying a lot for that speed. The gravel patio is a nice idea if you're tired of mowing and watering.
